provenance.fit_reference_world: merge_s 0, dead_bias 1, renewal dropout, seed 0: decoder.fit counts on dev_pooled (six Metrica halves)
provenance.public_window: Selection read only the Metrica dev worlds in sweep_worlds. The marginal temper grid {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2} was set from a public-window smoke test that put temper's useful range at 0.01 to 0.1. The m2 worlds merge Metrica spells under 2 s because raw Metrica spells are much shorter than the public window's, though 2 s was not fitted to the window. The decoder dead_bias 1.0 was selected from a {1, 3} axis whose 1.0 is the flat default, argued partly from a public-window count. These choices were committed on 2026-10-21. EVALUATION.md had said since 2026-09-24 to use the window to check correctness and never to choose between two versions. Upstream f8f2629 (2026-10-23) made RULES.md say the window is not training data and not a tuning set. v1 won this sweep on dev but was set aside the same day, on CHALLENGE.md and public-window figures (23 predicted possessions against 17, spellF1 0.310 against 0.412). On controlled-possession dev worlds it later lost to v0 at 5 s (-0.026 spellF1) and tied at 3 s. This public_window text was added by hand on 2026-10-24, and the command above does not write it. See possession/DESIGN.md, Measurements and constant provenance.
provenance.selection: max over candidates of the min pooled-dev spellF1 across worlds, ties by the mean; NaN (refused as flicker) in any world disqualifies
